title: Lenses, roles and loops
subtitle: How LLMs and agents work: a prompt as a lens, a role as a model with a description, an agent as a loop, tools as requests, no memory, compression, and focused threads. 13 panels.
book_version: v1.0.0 is the only official version; the second edition is in release candidates (rc1 and rc2 frozen)
by: gen-z.journalist, 18 October 2026, from Dinis's memo on LLMs and agents
rule: Every line the Guide says, and every quote card, is from the article 'Lenses, roles and loops', word for word; the build checks it. The five lenses on recursion, the weather question and the named threads are the storyboard's illustrations.

scenes.title: Lenses, roles and loops
scenes.subtitle: It stops being magic when you see how it works.
scenes.note: The second half of the generative AI chapter: what happens when you use a model.

scenes.caption: One idea, recursion, through five lenses
scenes.note: To a model, translating into another language is no different from translating for an audience: the prompt is the lens. The five analogies are the storyboard's, not the memo's.
scenes.source: Lenses, roles and loops, A prompt is a lens

scenes.caption: The wrong lens

cast.says: I've always been bad at maths.
The analogy is the reason someone understands something.

scenes.note: Priya ran rotas, budgets and stock levels for years: maths all day, just not the kind school called maths.
scenes.source: Lenses, roles and loops, A prompt is a lens

scenes.caption: A role is a model with a description

nodes.label: role.md: who you are, what you refuse

scenes.note: The same model behind every role on this site; what changes is the description and the question.
scenes.source: Lenses, roles and loops, A role is a model with a description

scenes.caption: An agent is a loop with a goal

cast.says: Fundamentally the agent is simply a task: do this; then, are we done yet, or do we need to continue?

scenes.note: And rinse and repeat. The loop is the skeleton; good agents add planning, checks and limits.
scenes.source: Lenses, roles and loops, An agent is a loop with a goal

scenes.caption: The loop, with one tool call

nodes.label: a tool call: search the web

scenes.note: The model never runs a tool: it writes a request; the program around it decides, runs it and sends the result back. If the answer to 'are we done?' is no, round again.
scenes.source: Lenses, roles and loops, Tools changed everything; Precisely

scenes.caption: What the next request carries
scenes.note: Two requests for one answer; the second holds everything the first did, plus the tool's result. (A made-up example.)
scenes.source: Lenses, roles and loops, Tools changed everything

scenes.caption: From training only, to tools
scenes.note: Training is a compression of the world, frozen on the day it ended; tools let the model ask for what it does not hold.
scenes.source: Lenses, roles and loops, Tools changed everything

scenes.caption: It remembers nothing

cast.says: So it doesn't remember what I said an hour ago?

scenes.note: Every request carries the whole conversation; that is why there is a context window, and why long chats get slower.
scenes.source: Lenses, roles and loops, It remembers nothing

scenes.caption: Long chats are compressed
scenes.note: One session, one month: summarised eighteen times, each summary keeping on average 1.7% of what it replaced (re-anchoring, newsroom). What the summary leaves out is not forgotten; it was never given back.
scenes.source: Lenses, roles and loops, Long chats are compressed

scenes.caption: The newsroom's answer

evidence.quote: The rules are restored, not remembered.

scenes.note: The rules live in a file printed back after every summary.
scenes.source: Lenses, roles and loops, Long chats are compressed

scenes.caption: Many focused threads, each with a name
scenes.note: One topic per session keeps what each model has to hold small; the sessions talk through files, never through memory. The thread names are illustrative.
scenes.source: Lenses, roles and loops, Many focused threads

scenes.caption: Where the memory is

evidence.quote: Nothing is remembered by the model between sessions. Everything is remembered by the files.
evidence.source: Memory is not a spectator sport (newsroom)

scenes.note: The principle the threads rely on.
scenes.source: Lenses, roles and loops, Long chats are compressed

scenes.punchline: Not magic: a lens, a role, a loop.
scenes.note: Understand it, and you are the one who sets the constraints.
scenes.source: Lenses, roles and loops, Why this matters
